The scene features thousands of delicate filaments that meander and grow organically through the fluid background, while glowing spherical clusters drift slowly through the depths. These clusters pulse rhythmically with their own internal life, responding to mouse proximity by accelerating their pulse and sending ripples through the surrounding medium. The color palette draws from cool mauves, grays, and iridescent silver hues to evoke a deep, mysterious underwater world where life stirs just beneath the surface. The entire composition moves continuously without external input, with each element maintaining its own subtle motion while reacting to the cursor's presence.
